name: paperclip-pixels
description: Workspace root for the Paperclip <-> Pixel Agents bridge: the neutral `@decaf-ts/paperclip-pixels-common` contract package (`common`), the independent Paperclip plugin (`plugins/paperclip`), and the independent Pixel Agents plugin surface with the embedding bundle (`plugins/pixel-agents`).

scripts.prepare-release: npm run test:release && npm run prepare-release --workspaces
